classification.difficultyReason: Rearrange the area rule to obtain sinθ=7/8, recognise both acute and obtuse included angles, and convert both results to degrees and minutes.

content.prompt: A triangle with two sides with lengths 4 cm and 8 cm, and an included angle $\theta$, has an area of $14\text{ cm}^2$. Find the value(s) of $\theta$. Give your answers to the nearest minute.

spec.description: Unshaded triangle with a horizontal base, upper vertex left of centre, side labels 4 and 8, and theta inside their included angle. Source proportions are schematic.
spec.mathematics: The sides of lengths 4 cm and 8 cm enclose theta. No base length or vertex names are supplied.

answer.worked:
$\begin{align*}14&=\tfrac12\times4\times8\sin\theta\\\sin\theta&=\tfrac78\end{align*}$
Since $0^\circ<\theta<180^\circ$, both an acute and an obtuse angle are possible.
$\begin{align*}\theta&=\sin^{-1}\!\left(\tfrac78\right)\quad\text{or}\quad180^\circ-\sin^{-1}\!\left(\tfrac78\right)\\\theta&\approx61^\circ3'\quad\text{or}\quad118^\circ57'\end{align*}$
